angles.name: When Plans Shift
angles.hook: Your gate changed. Your protection shouldn't.
angles.concept: A traveller watches a departure screen update in the dusk-lit hall, then calmly checks their phone. Cut to their holdall beside a glowing amber sign.

angles.name: Built for the Unexpected
angles.hook: The best travel plans leave room for chaos.
angles.concept: One traveller wheels their holdall through the blue glass entrance as signs reflect in the windows. A flight notification briefly appears on their phone; they keep moving.

angles.name: Protection Without the Panic
angles.concept: Close-up of a traveller stopping the holdall and calmly checking their phone. The phone lowers; the traveller continues toward the departure gate with composed focus.

scores.reason: It targets the specific anxiety of a sudden travel change and immediately reframes protection as the stable, dependable factor.
The chaos-versus-preparedness insight is credible, but the broad hook and generic visual may feel more like a brand statement than a sharply observed tension.
The calm reaction makes the benefit tangible, though “no meltdown” risks feeling unrealistic and may suggest an absolute level of control.

selection_reason: “When Plans Shift” wins because it starts from a highly recognizable moment—unexpectedly changing travel plans—and turns coverage into the thing that stays reliable. Its concise, sound-independent headline and clear departure-screen visual can stop attention quickly while directly supporting the core message without overclaiming.
audience_insight: Travelers worry that one sudden disruption can unravel their whole trip, but they feel calmer when they know dependable protection is already in place.
